name: cleanroom_enzgfm_nested_outer_v2
reason: v1 post-freeze audit found substantial exact-pair/entity overlap between the clean2023 Gate A/B development associations and every frozen outer test cell; no outer ranking metric was read before invalidation

inner_selection.fold_definition: same strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint stable hash folds inside the outer training split
inner_selection.selection_rule: same select_cleanroom_bidirectional_multifold percentile rule: highest mean joint percentile, then worst-fold percentile, then lower variability

final_fit: for each cell, reinitialize the selected dual tower and train on all of that cell's train_pairs only with dev_fold=-1; no inner-fold checkpoint is reused

evaluation.reactzyme_projection_boundary: Rhea-level projected Catalyst benchmark, separate from ReactZyme author-native task
evaluation.temporal_boundary: post-2020 UniProt creation-date extrapolation, not a strict historical source snapshot
